packages.name: Checkpoint
packages.title: Checkpoint
packages.author: Bernardo Giordano, FlagBrew
packages.description: Fast and simple homebrew save management framework for 3DS and Switch.
packages.changelog:
### 3DS: What's new

- Added: **WarioWare: D.I.Y. save backup and restore**. Its 16 MB save lives in NAND inside the cartridge instead of on a save chip, where no 3DS save interface can reach it. Checkpoint now talks to the cartridge directly, so you back it up and restore it from the title list like any other DS cart: no GodMode9i, no rebooting into DS mode.
  - This is particularly exciting because the strategy used to allow this functionality without rebooting in DS mode is brand new and this was thought to be impossible to achieve in the past.
  - A backup takes about a minute. A restore only rewrites the pages that differ from what is already on the cartridge, and reads every page it writes back to verify it. Restoring the backup you just made writes nothing at all; the worst case, where every page differs, takes about 6.5 minutes.
  - Checkpoint's dumps were checked byte for byte against GodMode9i's dumps of the same cartridge.
  - **The CIA build is required.** The 3DSX build can't reach the cartridge controller, so it refuses instead of reading.
  - So far this has been tested on one European cartridge. Other regions, and the other carts that save the same way, are recognised but not verified yet: *please* report back.
  - Don't remove the cartridge or turn off the console during a restore. Pages that were already written stay written, so an interrupted restore leaves the save half old and half new until you run it again.
- Fixed: DS cart backups no longer fail at random while writing to the SD card.
- Fixed: backing up the extdata of the theme entries no longer fails.
- General system stability improvements to enhance the user's experience.

### Switch: What's new

- Fixed: **restoring a save no longer inflates it to over 64 MB**. Since 5.1.0, every restore extended the save data area by its safety margin even when the backup already fit, so a 2 MB save came back at 65 MB. The area is now extended only when the backup actually needs more room

packages.name: Ferry-Switch
packages.title: Ferry
packages.author: DanilKhmyrov
packages.description: FTP server and file browser for Nintendo Switch — SD card, NAND, installed games and save data over Wi-Fi
packages.changelog:
Path handling fixes, one of them contributed.

**Absolute paths.** WinSCP sends `DELE` with an absolute path, and `localPath()` resolved it against the client's current directory as well — so the server looked for the file underneath itself and answered `550 Could not delete file`. Uploads were unaffected only because WinSCP changes into the folder first and sends a bare filename. Fixed in #1 by @DaneStack, who found it, built the project and sent the patch.

**Paths climbing out of their root.** Nothing folded `.` and `..` out of a name. For the SD and NAND roots that changed nothing — the prefix is a device and there is nothing above it — but under **Installed Games** the writable `Installs` folder is a prefix inside the card, and `../../../boot.dat` resolved onto the card's root and was writable from there. That root's documented promise is that `Installs` is the one writable place in it; it now holds. Paths are folded and clamped at their root.

**CWD inside Installs.** `changeDirectory()` worked out the root prefix separately from `localPath()` and never learned about `Installs`, so it checked `sdmc:` plus the path instead — a different directory, which could be missing when the real one exists or exist when it doesn't. Both now share one code path.

Verified by compiling the real folding function on the host and running every root and escape attempt through it.

packages.changelog:
## First build 🎉

Initial public release of GameTime Tracker.

**Features:**
- Loads playtime for all your installed games on startup, with a live progress bar
- Main menu lists every game with total days played (left) and hours played (right)
- Real game icons, decoded from your console's own data
- Per-game detail view — scroll through individual days and see exactly how long you played on each one
- Runs on firmware 20.5.0

**Controls:**
- D-pad / left stick — navigate
- A — open game details
- B — back / exit

**Requirements:**
- Modded / chipped console

Grab `GameTime.Tracker.v1.1.0.nro` below and drop it into `/switch/switch-playtime/` on your SD card.

---
**Update note:** I've now added the full source code to the repository (previously the `.nro` was compiled but the source wasn't public). No functionality has changed — if you already downloaded the `.nro` from this release, there's no need to redownload it.

---

## Перший реліз 🎉

Перший публічний реліз GameTime Tracker.

**Можливості:**
- Завантажує час гри у всіх встановлених іграх при запуску, з живим індикатором прогресу
- Головне меню показує кожну гру з кількістю зіграних днів (зліва) та годинами (справа)
- Справжні іконки ігор, декодовані з даних самої консолі
- Детальний перегляд по грі — можна погортати окремі дні й побачити, скільки часу зіграно в кожен із них
- Працює на прошивці 20.5.0

**Керування:**
- Хрестовина / лівий стік — навігація
- A — відкрити деталі гри
- B — назад / вихід

**Вимоги:**
- Прошита / чіпована консоль

Завантажте `GameTime.Tracker.v1.1.0.nro` нижче і закиньте його в `/switch/switch-playtime/` на SD-карті.

---
**Примітка про оновлення:** Я додав повний вихідний код у репозиторій (раніше `.nro` був скомпільований, але сурс не був публічним). Функціонал не змінився — якщо ви вже завантажували `.nro` з цього релізу, перекачувати заново немає сенсу.

---

- Search now covers the whole xCloud catalog with availability flags (#64)

packages.title: Kirikiroid2-NX
packages.author: Erige005 (Kirikiroid2 by zeas2)
packages.description: Kirikiroid2 for Nintendo Switch - the first port of Kirikiroid2 (KiriKiri2/krkr visual novel player) to Switch homebrew
packages.changelog:
**Kirikiroid2-NX v1.0.1** — compatibility fixes.

### What's new
- **windowEx plugin** added (the Android APK has it built in). Games that call `Window.registerExEvent()` and other windowEx methods no longer stop with *Member "registerExEvent" does not exist* — e.g. **Ninki Seiyuu: How to Make a Pop Voice Actress** (#1).
- **Modal dialogs close properly.** A dialog opened with `showModal()` is now hidden when it closes. Before, a game's own dialog (e.g. Ninki Seiyuu's language selection) stayed on screen, or left the game on a black screen.
- **No more black bars on 16:9 games.** The screen was set up as 960×640 internally, so 16:9 games (most of them) got thin black bars at the top and bottom and the UI was slightly squashed. It now uses the real 1280×720.
- The log file is saved to the SD card once a second, so it is kept even when you close the app with HOME.

### Install / update
1. Download `Kirikiroid2-NX.nro` below and copy it to `sdmc:/switch/` (replace the old one).
2. Open the Homebrew Menu in **title-takeover mode** (hold **R** while launching a game) and start Kirikiroid2-NX. Applet mode (from the Album) does not have enough memory for most games.
3. Copy your game folder to the SD card as you would for Kirikiroid2 on Android and open `data.xp3` from the file selector.

### Known issues
- Yes/No system message boxes always pick the first button.
- Plugins not ported yet: KAGParserEx, E-mote/motion player, scriptsEx, layerExRaster, layerExMosaic, shrinkCopy and others.
- Exiting a game may show "The software was closed because an error occurred".
- Software renderer only.

Logs for bug reports are written to `sdmc:/switch/kirikiroid2/` (`k2s_boot.txt`, `k2s_log.txt`, `k2s_log.prev.txt`, `k2s_crash.txt`) — please attach them to issues.

No game data is included. Use only games you legally own. `LICENSE` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` apply to the binary.

packages.changelog:
Today marks one year since the last update, so I thought I'd add a couple more features! This will likely be the last major update from myself as I have kind of lost interest in continuing development on NX-Activity-Log, however I plan to continue to support it by fixing any major bugs due to newer firmwares, etc.

As always, I appreciate all the support I've received regarding this software and I hope it continues to be of use to all of you who use it! :)

### Changelog:
* Added data export to JSON
  * All data shown in the app (both Recent Activity 'events' and All Activity 'summaries' are exported
  * See the [wiki](https://github.com/tallbl0nde/NX-Activity-Log/wiki) for the format of the JSON
* Added a basic, experimental import from JSON
  * **This only imports data to NX-Activity-Log, the system's log isn't touched**
  * Data is only imported to Recent Activity due to limitations on merging All Activity
* Added 'Adjust Playtime' setting
  * This setting allows for the playtime shown in All Activity to be increased/decreased in order to make up for lost time, etc.
  * These changes are applied on a per-user basis
  * This may be useful when importing data as the import doesn't change the values shown in All Activity
* Added 'Hide Titles' setting
  * Titles can be marked as hidden in order to hide them from all screens in NX-Activity-Log

The overlay now works on **SysNAND (sysMMC)**, not just emuMMC. That is the whole
of this release: no change to the UTF-8 conversion, the directory-name filter,
or the supported firmware list.

> **Supersedes v3.2.0's SysNAND warning.** That release said "Do not use this KIP
> on SysNAND … Supporting SysNAND is out of scope." The cause has been found and
> fixed. SysNAND is supported as of this version.

## Support Matrix

| HOS | SysNAND | emuMMC |
|---|---|---|
| 19.0.1 | ✅ **TESTED (3/3)** | ✅ TESTED (3/3) |
| 20.2.0 / 20.5.0 | ✅offset verified | ✅ TESTED (3/3) |
| 21.2.0 | ✅offset verified | ✅offset verified |
| 22.0.0 | ✅offset verified | ✅offset verified |
| 22.5.0 | ✅ **TESTED (3/3)** | ✅ **TESTED (3/3)** |
| **23.0.0 / 23.0.1** | ✅ **TESTED (3/3)** | ✅ **TESTED (3/3)** |

- **TESTED (3/3)** — real-hardware PASS for direct CJK read/write, `/ROM`
  enumeration showing the CJK directory, and enumeration *inside* the CJK
  directory.
- **offset verified** — the `matches_fs` opcode checks pass against that
  version's FS image. For the RTLD site this also means the site opcode matches
  *and* the branch delta decoded from its immediate matches the table, so the
  patch cannot land at a wrong target. On-console regression of that exact
  combination is still pending.

The 21.2.0 RTLD site sits at a **higher** offset (`0x2E1C0`) than 22.0.0's
(`0x2DED0`) despite being an older release. Every offset was measured against
the actual image rather than derived by shifting, for exactly that reason.

### Custom catalogs 🎉

Your home screen is now yours to arrange.

![Catalogs screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scamNscoot/StreamFin/main/images/capture-catalogs.jpg)

- **Catalog addons**: add a `catalog=URL` line to `streamfin-addon.txt` with any Stremio catalog addon's manifest URL — every catalog it offers appears as a home row (streaming-service catalogs, MDBList/Trakt lists, anime catalogs, …). Repeat the line for several addons.
- **Catalogs screen**: press **+** on the home screen. Toggle any row on/off with **A** — the built-in Cinemeta rows included — and reorder with **X/Y**. The home screen follows your arrangement, and it persists.
- Catalog addon manifests are refreshed on every launch: new catalogs appear automatically, removed ones disappear, your order and toggles are preserved.

### Also

- Skeleton (loading) tiles can now hold the focus highlight.
- Includes everything from v0.2.3 (column-true navigation, debrid guidance, focus glow, new icon). Existing configs carry over unchanged.

Thanks to everyone filing issues — keep them coming.

packages.name: StremNX
packages.title: StremNX
packages.author: stremnx
packages.description: Unofficial Stremio client for Nintendo Switch homebrew. MainStream-style UI, Stremio addons & account sync, mpv player, built-in torrent engine and SD card downloads. Not affiliated with Stremio.
packages.changelog:
Bug fix release for subtitles and the freezes some people hit in 0.3.0.

## Fixes
- **Subtitles from addons often did not show up.** OpenSubtitles v3 (the official Stremio subtitles addon) is now always available, even when it is not on your account or you are not logged in. Pick your language in **Settings → Subtitles**.
- Subtitle files and downloaded videos are passed to the player with a path it always understands.
- The app could freeze while a stream was stalled (a torrent without peers, a slow link). The player no longer waits on mpv for its state.
- The torrent engine could get stuck waiting for network packets and freeze the screen with it.
- Pausing or deleting a download no longer holds the screen.

## New
- The player tells you when there are no subtitles in your language for a video.
- A watchdog writes to `log.txt` where the app got stuck if it ever freezes for more than 4 seconds. If you still get a freeze, wait ~5 seconds, close the app and attach `sdmc:/switch/stremnx/log.txt` to an [issue](https://github.com/denpingus/StremNX/issues) (look for lines starting with `WATCHDOG:`).

## Install / update
Copy `stremnx.nro` to `sdmc:/switch/stremnx/stremnx.nro` (replace the old one) and open it from the Homebrew Menu in **title mode** (hold **R** while launching a game). Your login, history and downloads are kept.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Unofficial client — not affiliated with or endorsed by Stremio or Nintendo. StremNX ships with no content or piracy addons.

# Switch-Super-Installer v1.0.1

A fix for the latest firmware.

## What's new
- **Fixes a crash on firmware 23.x.** SSI is now built with the latest devkitA64 toolchain (libnx 4.12.0), which fixes the crash that happened when SSI started or closed on firmware 23.0.1. Builds made with the older toolchain (libnx 4.6.0) crash on that firmware.
- Tested on firmware 23.0.1 with Atmosphère 1.12.0: launch and exit, network install of a 5 GB game, uninstall, covers, screenshots, sleep mode and Wi-Fi.
- The texts added for Switch-Super-Manager (remote management, save backups, uninstall requests, network status) are now translated in German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Ukrainian and Chinese (they were shown in English).
- The Docker build script (`build_docker.ps1`) is pinned to the toolchain image and no longer stops at compiler warnings.

## Install
Copy `Switch-Super-Installer-v1.0.1.nro` to `/switch/` on your SD card (rename it `Switch-Super-Installer.nro`) and launch it from the Homebrew Menu.

## Notes
- Source code for this exact release: this repository at tag `v1.0.1` (GNU GPL v3).
- Use only with games you own. No keys or games are provided. Not affiliated with Nintendo.
- SHA-256 of the `.nro`: `f2e14ebf54e104b9136a43994bcb694eaea244bc225dadb8a151046f597fa907`

packages.changelog:
## **List of Changes**
1. `;toggle_state_condition=` now works on source-based toggles (by @Niklas080208 in https://github.com/ppkantorski/Ultrahand-Overlay/pull/333).
    - Toggles built from `file_source`, `list_source`, `json_source` or `ini_file_source` can now take each item's ON/OFF state from a condition, so states such as INI-backed hide flags are shown correctly after a reload.
    - The condition can use `{file_name}`, `{folder_name}`, `{file_source}` and `{index}` for each item.
    - In condition mode, turning an item ON runs `on:` and turning it OFF runs `off:`, the same as package-level toggles.
    - Condition arguments now support spaces and apostrophes, including quoted paths in `;visibility_condition=`. Existing conditions behave exactly as before.
2. Added `home-press` and `home-hold` commands to simulate the HOME menu button.
    - `home-press` presses the HOME button, opening the HOME menu.
    - `home-hold` holds the HOME button, opening the quick settings menu (sleep mode / brightness / airplane mode).
3. Checkmarks and crossmarks on regular list items now return to the item's footer after 3 seconds, instead of staying until the page is left.
4. A **10 MB** option is now available by default under Overlay Memory.
    - Your current overlay memory is not changed, and an existing custom memory value is left as is.
5. The **Launch Arguments** toggle in overlay settings now only appears when launch arguments have actually been set for that overlay.
6. Now bundled with `nx-ovlloader v2.0.3`.
7. Update Russian translations (by @redraz in https://github.com/ppkantorski/Ultrahand-Overlay/pull/330).
8. Various bug fixes and corrections.
    - Sleep / wake bug fixes in latest `libultrahand` (v2.5.4).
    - Fixed controller input leaking through to the eShop while the overlay is open on newer firmware in latest `libultrahand` (v2.5.4) (by @5l4k in https://github.com/ppkantorski/libultrahand/pull/20).
